## Definition of done (baseline for every task)

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion of the task is met (list them above if not obvious)
- [ ] Automated tests pass (CI is green), with at least one success-path and one failure-path test
- [ ] No secrets in the repository; new settings are added to `.env.example` and documented
- [ ] Errors and key events are logged
- [ ] README or docs updated
- [ ] Reviewed by the other team member before merging
- [ ] Demonstrated to the product owner
